description: This Lua source file contains tests and diagnostics related to Lua's garbage collection (GC) system. It includes assertions, sample object creation, cycle detection, weak table manipulations, error handling during GC, userdata tests, and practical usage scenarios for different GC modes and steps.

methods.name: nop
methods.description: A no-operation function used as a placeholder __gc method.

methods.name: gcinfo
methods.description: Returns current memory usage in bytes, calculated as collectgarbage('count') * 1024.

methods.name: GC1
methods.description: Creates objects with __gc metamethods to test garbage collection activation and collection of different object types.

methods.name: GC2
methods.description: Runs GC1 and GC2 to perform combined garbage collection tests.
